---
title: "Figure 4D - Vaccination-timing correlation heatmap"
output: html_document
---

This notebook summarizes feature-wise Spearman correlations for infants whose
mothers received their first vaccine dose at 28-32 or 32-36 gestational weeks.
Run `01_load_data.Rmd` first.

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

helper_dir <- if (dir.exists("../helpful_functions")) {
  "../helpful_functions"
} else {
  "helpful_functions"
}
source(file.path(helper_dir, "data_io.R"))
source(file.path(helper_dir, "analysis_functions.R"))

stopifnot(all(vapply(
  c("new_sub_data_long", "persis_6m_df", "neg_control_threshold"),
  exists,
  logical(1)
)))
```

## 1. Calculate feature-wise Spearman correlations

```{r calculate-correlations}
spearman_by_feature <- function(data, group_name, require_detection = FALSE) {
  results <- lapply(split(data, data$features), function(feature_data) {
    complete <- complete.cases(feature_data$Vax1_days, feature_data$vals)
    x <- feature_data$Vax1_days[complete]
    y <- feature_data$vals[complete]

    can_test <- length(x) >= 3 && stats::sd(x) > 0 && stats::sd(y) > 0
    if (can_test) {
      test <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(
        x,
        y,
        method = "spearman",
        exact = FALSE
      ))
      rho <- unname(test$estimate)
      p_value <- test$p.value
    } else {
      rho <- NA_real_
      p_value <- NA_real_
    }

    if (require_detection) {
      feature <- feature_data$features[1]
      detected_fraction <- mean(
        feature_data$vals >= unname(neg_control_threshold[feature]),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
      if (detected_fraction <= 0.30) {
        rho <- NA_real_
      }
    }

    data.frame(
      feature = feature_data$features[1],
      rho = rho,
      p_value = p_value,
      timing_group = group_name
    )
  })
  bind_rows(results)
}

all_correlations <- spearman_by_feature(
  new_sub_data_long,
  "Entire third trimester"
)
early_correlations <- spearman_by_feature(
  new_sub_data_long[new_sub_data_long$vax_group == "<32_weeks", ],
  "28-32 weeks",
  require_detection = TRUE
)
late_correlations <- spearman_by_feature(
  new_sub_data_long[new_sub_data_long$vax_group == ">32_weeks", ],
  "32-36 weeks",
  require_detection = TRUE
)

correlation_results <- bind_rows(
  all_correlations,
  early_correlations,
  late_correlations
) %>%
  left_join(
    persis_6m_df %>% select(feature, persis_num),
    by = "feature"
  ) %>%
  separate(
    feature,
    into = c("antibody", "antigen"),
    sep = "_",
    extra = "merge",
    remove = FALSE
  )
```

## 2. Plot the 28-32 and 32-36 week correlation heatmaps

```{r plot-heatmap}
plot_data <- correlation_results %>%
  filter(timing_group != "Entire third trimester") %>%
  mutate(
    timing_group = factor(
      timing_group,
      levels = c("28-32 weeks", "32-36 weeks")
    ),
    antigen = gsub("_", " ", antigen),
    antibody = recode(
      antibody,
      IgG = "Total IgG",
      FcgR2AR = "FcgR2A",
      FcgR3AV = "FcgR3A"
    )
  )

figure_4d <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(antigen, antibody, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    name = "Spearman\ncorrelation",
    low = "#1207A3",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#BB0103",
    midpoint = 0,
    na.value = "gray"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  facet_grid(~timing_group) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      face = "bold",
      size = 15
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18)
  )
```

## 3. Save Figure 4D

```{r save-figure}
ggsave(
  output_path("Figure_4", "Figure_4D_correlation_heatmap.png"),
  figure_4d,
  width = 14,
  height = 7,
  units = "in"
)
```
